title: @-Mentions: Eindeutige Tokens bei Namens-Kollisionen
description: Falls zwei User denselben Vor- und Nachnamen haben oder Namensfelder leer sind, hätte ein @-Mention die falsche Person benachrichtigen können. Jetzt wird der vollständige Email-String genutzt, wenn der Kurz-Token nicht eindeutig ist; mehrdeutige Mentions werden serverseitig verworfen.
details: Frontend: Token fällt auf vollständige Email zurück, wenn firstname.lastname kollidiert oder fehlt
Backend: Bei mehrdeutigen Token-Matches wird die Notification verworfen (Warnung im Log) statt alle Treffer zu benachrichtigen
+5 neue Tests (3 Backend Edge-Cases, 2 Frontend Kollisions-Cases)

title: Code-Review-Fixes für 2.29.1
description: Mehrere Review-Findings behoben: blockierende Requests, potenziell rückdatierte Invoices und inkonsistente Fehleranzeige.
details: Auto-Link-Regeln: Matching läuft jetzt asynchron via Celery — GraphQL-Request blockiert nicht mehr auf Clockodo-API
@-Mention-Benachrichtigungen: werden nach DB-Commit via Celery verschickt, nicht mehr synchron im Request
Invoice-unabhängige One-Off-Items ohne Datum: werden geskippt (statt am alten Vertragsstart abgerechnet)
Customer-Attachment-Upload: Fehler als Banner statt blockierendem alert()

title: @-Mentions in Todo-Kommentaren
description: Tippe @ im Kommentarfeld, um Team-Mitglieder zu erwähnen. Erwähnte Nutzer erhalten eine E-Mail-Benachrichtigung.
details: Autocomplete-Dropdown beim Tippen von @ im Kommentarfeld
Unterstützte Formate: @firstname.lastname, @email-local-part, @vollständige@email
Erwähnte Nutzer erhalten E-Mail-Benachrichtigung (neuer Notification-Type todo_mention)
Self-Mentions und Cross-Tenant-Mentions werden ignoriert
Closes #10 (Assignee-Wechsel per Dropdown und Drag&Drop im Board waren bereits vorhanden)

title: Lieferverfolgung mit unabhängiger Abrechnung
description: Positionen mit Lieferverfolgung können jetzt unabhängig vom Lieferstatus abgerechnet werden — ideal für Vorauszahlungen, bei denen die Lieferung nur zur Dokumentation getrackt wird.
details: Neue Option 'Unabhängig abrechnen' im Position-Dialog neben ETA
Billing- und Recognition-Schedule berücksichtigen das Flag: Position wird abgerechnet trotz pending delivery
Auch Positionen mit Abhängigkeit zu einer pending-Position werden entsperrt, wenn unabhängig markiert
Closes #8

title: Auto-Link-Regeln werden sofort angewendet
description: Nach dem Erstellen einer Auto-Link-Regel werden passende Clockodo-Projekte sofort verknüpft — nicht erst nach bis zu 24 Stunden.
details: Fixed: Auto-Link-Regeln scannen beim Anlegen sofort die vorhandenen Projekte und legen Mappings an
Fehler beim Provider-Zugriff lassen die Regel trotzdem speichern — der nächtliche Task greift dann
Closes #7

title: Drag&Drop und Multi-File-Upload für Anhänge
description: Anhänge lassen sich jetzt per Drag&Drop hochladen; mehrere Dateien in einem Schritt möglich — bei Verträgen und Kunden.
details: Drag&Drop: Dateien direkt auf den Upload-Button oder die Anhangsliste ziehen
Multi-File: mehrere Dateien auf einmal auswählen oder droppen
Teilweise Fehler werden pro Datei angezeigt; erfolgreiche Uploads aktualisieren die Liste

title: Fix Attachment-Upload (fehlende Kategorie)
description: Beim Hochladen von Kundenanhängen wurde die Kategorie weder gespeichert noch zurückgegeben, was einen Fehler auslöste.
details: Fixed: Kategorie wird beim Upload in der DB gespeichert
Fixed: Kategorie wird im Response-Objekt zurückgegeben

title: Forecast Excel-Export & Export-Permission Lock
description: Revenue/Recognition Forecast kann jetzt als Excel exportiert werden. Export-Button zeigt Lock-Symbol bei fehlender Permission.
details: Forecast: Excel-Export der aktuell angezeigten Daten (Gruppierung, Typ, Ansicht)
Verträge: Export-Button zeigt Lock-Icon und ist deaktiviert ohne contracts.export Permission

title: Fix Forecast customer_number field ordering
description: Fixes GraphQL schema error for customer_number field in forecast queries.
details: Fixed dataclass field ordering: optional customer_number moved after required fields

title: Forecast Customer-Gruppierung & Clockodo-Projekte
description: Recognition/Revenue Forecast kann jetzt nach Kunde gruppiert werden. Neue Möglichkeit, Clockodo-Projekte direkt aus dem Vertrag heraus anzulegen.
details: Forecast: neue Gruppierung nach Kunde mit konsolidierten Beträgen und CUS-IDs
Time Tracking: Clockodo-Projekte direkt im Link-Dialog erstellen
Erzwungene Positionsverknüpfung bei neuem Projekt, wenn Wartungsprojekt bereits existiert

title: Fix absent days for users without time entries
description: Users who had no logged hours (e.g. full vacation month) now correctly show their absent days in the department time analysis.
details: Fixed absent days showing 0 for users without time entries in the period
Fixed home office filter in department analysis (type 8+9 instead of just 9)

title: Fix absence type mapping (vacation shown as sick)
description: The Clockodo absence type mapping was completely wrong — vacation was shown as sick, sick as sick certificate, etc. All reports need to be regenerated.
details: Fixed Clockodo absence type mapping: 1=vacation, 4=sick, 11=sick_certificate, etc.
Home office filter updated from type=9 to type=8 (correct Clockodo code)
All existing absence reports should be regenerated to show correct types

title: Department analysis permissions
description: New department_analysis permission resource with read, send, regenerate, and finalize actions. Regenerating finalized absence reports now works with proper permission.
details: New department_analysis permission with read, send, regenerate, finalize actions
Regenerating finalized absence reports requires department_analysis.regenerate
Send, finalize actions properly gated instead of using contracts permissions

title: Regenerate finalized absence reports
description: Finalized absence reports can now be regenerated (requires write permission). This resets the report to draft with fresh deduplicated data.
details: Regenerate button enabled for finalized reports (requires contracts.write permission)
Regenerating resets to draft, deletes old PDF, fetches fresh deduplicated data

title: Won Development expansion, XLSX report, PDF dedup
description: One-off expansion items now count toward Won Development. Department time report sends as proper XLSX without cost data. Absence PDF deduplicates overlapping entries.
details: One-off expansion items with deal_won_date count toward Won Development bookings
Info tooltips on each New Bookings card and info box on detail pages
Department time report sent as XLSX (not CSV), without cost column
Absence report PDF deduplicates overlapping entries at render time

title: Send Now button, absence dedup, column widths
description: Report settings now have a Send Now button for immediate sending. Absence report deduplicates overlapping Clockodo entries and uses equal 25% column widths.
details: Added Send Now button to report automation settings for immediate sending
Fixed duplicate absence entries from Clockodo (overlapping date ranges deduplicated)
Fixed inconsistent table column widths across employee sections (now 25% each)

title: Automated report sending and price increase bookings
description: Absence Reports and Department Time Analysis can now be sent automatically on a monthly schedule. Negotiated price increases count as B2B ARR bookings.
details: Automated monthly report sending for Absence Reports and Department Time Analysis CSV
Settings UI under Settings > General > Reports with recipients, send day, and auto-finalize
Blue info banner on tabs when auto-reporting is active, with link to settings
Auto-finalize option disables manual Finalize button for absence reports
Negotiated price increases now count as Back-to-Base ARR bookings
Price increase detection works for mid-year changes, not just Jan 1 vs Jan 1
Unified compact month selector buttons across Absences and Time Allocation tabs

title: Fix recognition for multi-year contracts
description: Multi-year contracts now recognize revenue annually instead of the full multi-year billing amount at once. A 120k triennial contract shows 40k/year in recognition view.
details: Recognition schedule uses annual intervals for multi-year contracts (biennial, triennial, etc.)
Revenue recognized in 12-month increments instead of full billing period amount

title: Exact match requires invoice number in text
description: Transaction matching now only shows 'Exact match' when both the amount matches and the invoice number appears in the transaction's booking text or reference.
details: Exact match badge now requires invoice number found in booking text or reference, not just amount match

title: Imported invoices appear in match suggestions
description: Imported invoices with 'extracted' status are now included in transaction matching suggestions and search, since most invoices are never manually confirmed.
details: Included 'extracted' status in imported invoice matching suggestions and search filters

title: Fix imported invoices in revenue forecast
description: Imported invoices now correctly match their billing period in the revenue forecast, using billing_date and the contract's billing interval instead of always assuming monthly.
details: Fixed imported invoices not appearing in revenue forecast due to incorrect period matching
Adapter now uses billing_date (from forecast upload) when available, falls back to invoice_date
Period derived from contract billing interval instead of always assuming one month
Date filter includes both billing_date and invoice_date for imported invoices

title: Fix attachment category selector crash
description: Fixed a crash in the attachment category dropdown caused by Radix Select rejecting empty string values.
details: Fixed empty string value crash in category Select components across contract and customer attachment views

title: API key generation with permissions
description: Users can now generate scoped API keys for programmatic access. Keys support X-API-Key header authentication with fine-grained permission control.
details: Generate API keys with name, scoped permissions, and optional expiry
Permission checkboxes enforce same-or-fewer permissions than the creating user
Token shown once on creation, stored as SHA256 hash
X-API-Key header authentication alongside existing JWT Bearer tokens
Key management UI in Settings > Integrations > API with list, revoke, and last-used tracking

title: New Bookings dashboard, attachments, and more
description: Reworked New Bookings metrics with correct New Name vs B2B split, added attachment permalinks and categories, contract reactivation, and delivered one-off forecast fixes.
details: Fixed New Name vs Back-to-Base ARR split: New Name = customer with no prior-year contracts/invoices, B2B = existing customers + expansion items with deal_won_date
Added drill-down detail page for each New Bookings card showing exact contributing items
Renamed New Business to New Bookings throughout (bookings, not invoiced revenue)
Added deal_won_date field per line item to distinguish real upsells from internal transfers
One-off items default to advanced_development revenue type
Delivered one-off items now appear in revenue forecast using delivered_at as billing date
Mark-as-delivered dialog prompts for billing start date on dependent items
Attachment permalinks with copy-link button and login-protected inline display
Attachment categories (order, contract, offer, other) with color badges and inline edit
Customer Documents tab showing all contract attachments with category filter
Contract reactivation from cancelled or ended status
Prior-year revenue check includes both invoices and active contracts

title: Change customer confirm dialog and icon
description: Change customer button now uses a building icon and requires explicit confirmation with a warning that all contract data, invoices, and attachments will be moved.
details: Building icon for change customer button
Two-step flow: pick customer, then confirm with warning about data migration
Warning explains that invoices and attachments are included in the move

title: Change customer button in contract header
description: The existing change customer action is now accessible as a prominent button in the contract edit view header, next to Delete and Merge.
details: Added Change Customer button with confirm dialog to contract edit view header

title: Fix move item database locking error
description: Fixed 'FOR UPDATE cannot be applied to the nullable side of an outer join' error when moving items with optional product references.
details: Fixed select_for_update on nullable product FK by using of=("self",)

title: Pre-fill effective date in move item dialog
description: The move item dialog now suggests the effective date automatically based on the last invoiced period, alignment date, or current billing cycle end.
details: Pre-fills effective date from last invoiced period end, alignment date minus one day, or billing period end

title: Move line items between contracts
description: Recurring line items can now be moved to another contract of the same customer with an effective date. Also fixes time tracking totals, adds credit card counterparty extraction, and enables ID-based search.
details: Added Move Item action to transfer recurring positions between contracts of the same customer
Move sets billing end date on source, creates copy with billing start date on target, with bidirectional links visible in the items table
Fixed time tracking monthly breakdown not summing to total hours due to inconsistent API call handling
Improved Clockodo API retry: 5 attempts with exponential backoff, Retry-After header support, and 5xx retry
Credit card MTA imports now extract counterparty names from transaction descriptions instead of showing Bank Fees / Unknown
Global search now finds contracts and customers by internal ID (e.g. searching 577)
Search result subtitles always show internal ID for quick identification
Fixed flaky liquidity forecast test on month-end dates

title: Counterparty account view and upload improvements
description: Counterparty detail page now shows a unified account ledger with Soll/Haben columns, year selector for summary cards, and invoice action icons. Invoice upload has a progress modal with duplicate detection.
details: Added Account tab to counterparty detail with unified Soll/Haben ledger and running Saldo
Year selector for counterparty summary cards (Invoiced, Paid, Outstanding, Cash Balance)
Upload progress modal with per-file status, progress bar, and non-dismissible during upload
Duplicate detection via SHA256 content hash and post-extraction field matching
Counterparty invoice tab: action icons for PDF view, details sheet, and transaction matching
Renamed Transactions tab to Bank Transactions with count badge
Fixed pagination i18n and hidden when 10 or fewer entries

title: Debit matching and incoming invoices redesign
description: Debit bank transactions can now be matched to incoming (supplier) invoices. The incoming invoices page has been redesigned to match the banking layout with sortable columns, filter card, and inline counterparty editing.
details: Match debit transactions to incoming invoices and credit notes via counterparty link
Redesigned incoming invoices page with banking-style filter card, sortable table, and pen icon for counterparty editing
Supplier name links to counterparty detail page when matched
Added Invoices tab to counterparty detail page showing linked incoming invoices
Invoice type badge now shows 'Incoming' instead of 'Generated' for supplier invoices
Added assistant.use permission for Cora AI chat (Admin and Manager roles)

title: Cora AI assistant and incoming invoice improvements
description: In-app AI chat assistant (Cora) answers questions about contracts, customers, and revenue using Claude API with GraphQL access. Incoming invoices gain PDF/ZIP upload, inbox debug view, searchable counterparty select, and auto-matching.
details: Added Cora AI assistant with floating chat button, SSE streaming, and 8 read-only tools plus arbitrary GraphQL queries
Added PDF and ZIP upload for incoming invoices with auto-extraction
Added inbox debug modal showing email processing status with auto-refresh
Replaced counterparty dropdown with searchable select, pre-filled with supplier name
Auto-assign counterparty from previously confirmed supplier-counterparty mappings
Inbox polling now processes all emails (not just unread), relies on DB deduplication
Test connection button now shows email count in folder
Fixed time tracking monthly breakdown not summing correctly for legacy mappings
Added UI conventions to CLAUDE.md (German date format, sortable tables, filter card pattern)

title: Smarter payment matching for unlinked counterparties
description: Payments can now be matched to invoices even when the counterparty isn't linked to a customer, using a combination of invoice number extraction, amount tolerance, and fuzzy company name matching.
details: Added fuzzy composite matching strategy for transactions with unlinked counterparties
Flexible invoice number extraction from booking text (handles partial numbers like 26-009 for INV-VSX-26-0009)
Integrated fee tolerance settings into amount matching (was exact-only before)
Counterparty-to-customer fuzzy name matching via rapidfuzz
Fixed forecast invoice matching to use exact billing_date before falling back to heuristic

title: Import invoices from revenue forecast
description: Upload PDF invoices directly from the revenue forecast tab with automatic extraction of invoice number, date, and amount. Failed extractions can now be edited manually on the invoice detail page.
details: Added PDF invoice upload button on revenue forecast billing periods without an invoice
Synchronous extraction with confirmation dialog to verify/edit extracted data before saving
Allowed manual editing of invoice fields when extraction fails
Clarified that PDF uploads on /invoices work independently from CSV imports
Improved sidebar nav touch targets, search input height, and table number alignment
Added color-scheme: light to prevent dark mode rendering artifacts
Hidden contract count badge while loading to prevent layout shift

title: Absence reports and billing start hint
description: Monthly absence reports can be generated, finalized, and sent via email from the department analysis page. Contract edit form now warns when billing start date differs from start date with minimum duration set.
details: Added monthly absence report with generation, finalization (PDF), and email sending
Integration-agnostic absence type normalization (Clockodo as first provider)
New 'Fehlzeiten' tab in department analysis page with grouped entries by employee
Added hint on contract edit form when billing start differs from start date with min duration

title: AB price periods and Goals improvements
description: Order confirmations now show per-period pricing with date ranges, correct billing interval labels, and separate recurring/one-off sections. The Goals unclassified list hides 0 EUR items and revenue types can be assigned to all contract items.
details: Added price period sub-rows with date ranges in order confirmations
Fixed billing interval labels (e.g. /Jahr, /Quartal instead of always /Monat)
Added separate recurring and one-off sections with subtotals in AB when both types exist
Skipped 0 EUR items in Goals unclassified revenue list
Enabled revenue type assignment for items whose product has no revenue type set

title: Invitation emails and customer active toggle
description: Invited users now receive an email with the inviter's name and a link to accept. Customer active status can be toggled from the detail page.
details: Added automatic invitation email with DE/EN templates showing inviter name and email
Customer status badge is now clickable to toggle active/inactive

title: Show contract ID in title
description: The internal contract ID is now displayed after the contract title for easier reference.
details: Added contract ID as [123] after the title on both detail and edit views

title: OC auto-linking and customer editing
description: Order confirmations now auto-populate the contract's OC number and create a link in attachments. Customers can be edited inline.
details: Order confirmation number is automatically written to the contract field on OC creation
A contract link to the OC detail page is created automatically (Auftragsbestätigung # ...)
Activation dialog now offers three options: create & send, create only, or skip OC
Warning shown when activating a contract that already has an OC number
Added inline editing for customer name and customer number (CUS...) on detail page

title: Todo notification links and Clockodo template fixes
description: Todo assignment emails now include links to the related entity. Clockodo project template placeholders are now case-insensitive and unmatched ones are cleaned up.
details: Added links to related entity and todos board in todo assignment notification emails
Todo reassignment now notifies the new assignee even when reassigned to the original creator
Fixed Clockodo project template placeholders being case-sensitive ({AB_number} now works)
Unmatched template placeholders are now stripped from Clockodo project names
Per-item Clockodo projects use the item's own AB number when available
Contract delete now redirects to the customer detail page instead of contract list

title: Move contracts between customers
description: Contracts can now be moved to a different customer regardless of status. FTE snapshot table now shows cost share percentage.
details: Enabled 'Change Customer' on active, paused, and cancelled contracts (previously draft-only)
Moving a non-draft contract creates a TERMS_CHANGED amendment for traceability
Replaced Income column with Cost Share % in FTE distribution snapshot table

title: Document email BCC settings
description: Configure BCC recipients per document type for outgoing emails. Credit notes are no longer shown in transaction invoice matching.
details: Added BCC Recipients tab in Settings > Email Templates with per-type configuration (invoices, credit notes, order confirmations, offers)
BCC recipients are sent via Microsoft Graph API bccRecipients on all outgoing document emails
Excluded credit notes from suggested matches and invoice search in banking transaction matching

title: Fix CI: add missing tenants migration
description: Added untracked tenants migration that was causing all CI backend tests to fail with NodeNotFoundError.
details: Committed tenants migration 0016_add_cost_center_permissions (was on disk but untracked)
Fixed banking.0013_fte_distribution_snapshot dependency resolution in CI

title: Fix credit note sending & audit log improvements
description: Credit notes (stornos) can now be sent via email again. Audit log filter now includes invoice and todo entity types.
details: Fixed credit note email sending — was blocked by finalized-only status check
Added invoice and todo entity types to audit log filter dropdown
Defaulted contract list view to show active contracts

title: FTE-based payroll split & activation workflow
description: Departments can now link to cost centers with FTE-based payroll splitting using automatic monthly snapshots. Contract activation consolidates checklist, order confirmation, and Clockodo setup into a single workflow modal.
details: Added Department→CostCenter link with FTE distribution snapshots for payroll cost splitting
Added FTE-based split rule mode alongside existing percentage and revenue-based modes
Automatic monthly FTE snapshot capture via Celery task with Clockodo fallback
Department settings UI for cost center picker, FTE distribution, and snapshot management
Unified contract activation workflow modal with checklist validation, order confirmation toggle, and Clockodo setup
Server-side order confirmation creation on contract activation (replaces client-side orchestration)
Added regenerateOrderConfirmationPdf mutation for retry on failed PDF generation

title: Contract merge & scoped offers
description: Merge a source contract's items into a target contract of the same customer, with date overrides, amendment tracking, and HubSpot deal ID preservation. Offers can now be scoped to specific contract items.
details: Added 'Merge into...' action on draft/active contracts without invoices
Merge dialog with target contract selector, item preview table, and per-item date editing
Automatic amendment creation when merging into active contracts
HubSpot deal ID preserved on transferred items for traceability
Atomic merge with source contract deletion and Clockodo mapping cleanup
Added scoped offer creation — generate offers for a subset of contract items
Clockodo impact preview shown during merge when applicable

title: Contract list & customer detail performance
description: Fixed N+1 query issues in contract list and customer detail pages by adding proper prefetching for items, price periods, and groups.
details: Added prefetch_related for contract items and price periods in contract list query
Added select_related for contract groups with annotated count to avoid per-row queries
Optimized ARR and monthly recurring value field resolvers to use prefetched data
Added prefetching to customer detail contracts resolver
Added select_related for todo resolver related models

title: Accounting settings tab & todo reassignment
description: Reorganized settings with a new Accounting tab and improved todo board with reassignment and drag-and-drop across columns.
details: Added Accounting top-level settings tab with Revenue Goals and Cost Centers sub-tabs
Moved Cost Centers and Split Rules from Banking to Accounting settings
Moved Revenue Goals from General to Accounting settings
Assignees can now reassign todos to other team members (not just creators)
Todo reassignment and unassignment now create auto-comments for audit trail
Improved todo board with droppable columns for cross-column drag-and-drop

title: Cost centers, incoming invoices & split rules
description: Added cost center management with automatic and manual transaction splitting, incoming invoice import via email polling, and cost center split rules.
details: Added cost centers (Kostenstellen) with settings UI for creating and managing cost centers
Added cost center split rules with counterparty and booking text matching for automatic transaction assignment
Added manual transaction cost center splitting with proportional amount distribution
Added cost center report page with aggregated transaction data per cost center
Added incoming invoice import via email inbox polling (M365/IMAP)
Added invoice inbox settings for configuring email sources
Added incoming invoices list and detail pages with extracted invoice data display
Fixed Django 5 compatibility and Strawberry input type issues

title: Back-to-Base ARR metric on dashboard
description: Split Won New ARR into New Name ARR (new customer deals) and Back-to-Base ARR (expansion on existing contracts) for better new business tracking.
details: Added Back-to-Base ARR card on dashboard showing expansion/upsell revenue from line items added to existing contracts
Renamed 'Won New ARR' to 'New Name ARR' to clarify it tracks HubSpot deal-based new customer revenue
Added Back-to-Base ARR goal type in Revenue Goal Settings
Added arr_delta field on contract amendments for amendment-level revenue tracking
Added Beta badges to New Business and Price Increase Impact dashboard sections

title: Invoice status display and liquidity forecast fixes
description: Unified invoice status badges across all views and fixed liquidity forecast income projection and totals calculation.
details: Unified invoice status display with shared InvoiceStatusBadge component across all views (invoices, customers, contracts)
Added invoice lifecycle stepper on invoice detail page showing Created → Sent → Paid progression
Renamed 'Finalized' status to 'Created' for clarity
Fixed liquidity forecast totals row showing 0 due to GraphQL Decimal string coercion
Fixed projected income using billing schedule net amounts instead of gross (now applies tax rate)
Fixed double-counting of paid invoices in liquidity forecast by tracking all invoice statuses
Finalized-but-not-sent invoices now use today+30 days as expected payment date
Added tenant name setting in Settings > General

title: Fix HubSpot deal sync for custom pipelines
description: Fixed deal sync that missed closed-won deals in custom pipelines, and added a debug sync UI for diagnosing and manually triggering syncs.
details: Fixed closed-won stage detection to use HubSpot pipeline API instead of hard-coded 'closedwon' stage ID
Added Debug Sync section in Settings > HubSpot with deal lookup and date-range resync
Deal check shows pipeline, stage, associated company, and explains why a deal was or wasn't synced
Date-range resync supports filtered sync for customers, products, and deals without updating last-sync timestamps

title: Clockodo activation dialog improvements
description: Improved the contract activation workflow with inline Clockodo customer linking, project naming templates, and config overwrite fix.
details: Added inline customer create/link in the Clockodo activation dialog with searchable select
Added {ab_number} placeholder for project naming templates
Added project naming templates settings UI under Time Tracking > Projects
Fixed save_time_tracking_settings overwriting project templates
Skipped order confirmation dialog when contract already has an AB number
Added next-steps hint to the activation confirmation dialog
Filtered archived Clockodo customers from linking dropdown
Fixed i18n interpolation in Clockodo dialog strings

title: Liquidity analysis
description: New liquidity analysis on the Forecasts page combining actual bank data with projected costs and income.
details: Added liquidity analysis service combining actual bank transactions with projected costs (recurring patterns) and projected income (revenue forecast with 60-day payment delay)
Added stacked bar chart with cumulative balance line on the Liquidity tab
Added monthly summary table with actual, projected, and total columns for costs and income
Paid invoices are automatically subtracted from projected income to avoid double-counting

title: Tenant self-signup
description: New tenants can now sign up publicly with email verification and automatic login.
details: Added public signup page with company name, name, email, and password
Added email verification flow that activates the tenant and auto-logs in
Added SignupVerification model with rate limiting (5 per email per hour)
Added system SMTP configuration for pre-tenant transactional emails
Added SIGNUP_ENABLED setting to control public signup availability
Added conditional signup link on login page

title: Search dropdown improvements
description: Wider search results, no longer clipped by sidebar, and a keyboard shortcut hint.
details: Widened search results dropdown to 480px to show full names
Fixed dropdown being clipped at the sidebar boundary
Added / keyboard hint badge in the search input

title: Global search finds pages and settings tabs
description: The sidebar search now finds all navigable pages, settings tabs, and sub-tabs with keyboard navigation support.
details: Added client-side page search matching all nav pages and settings sub-tabs by label and keywords (EN/DE)
Added keyboard navigation: arrow keys to select, Enter to open, Escape to close
Search links directly to sub-tabs (e.g., Notifications, Roles, Order Confirmation Email)
Fixed double scrollbar on dashboard
Fixed 2FA status display on user settings page
Renamed German Audit Log translation to Auditlog
Fixed TodoBoard heading style consistency

title: 2FA tenant enforcement flow
description: When a tenant enforces two-factor authentication, users are now properly redirected to a setup page on login.
details: Added /setup-2fa page for users required to enable 2FA by their organization
Backend scope validation restricts 2FA-setup tokens to only setup mutations
Login detects enforcement and redirects to setup before granting app access

title: Settings restructured: Documents, Numbering, Email Templates
description: The overloaded Invoice Settings tab (9 sub-tabs) has been split into three focused top-level tabs for better navigation.
details: New 'Documents' tab: Company Data, PDF Template, Zugferd
New 'Numbering' tab: Invoice, Credit Note, Offer, and Order Confirmation numbering schemes in one place
New 'Email Templates' tab: Invoice Email and Order Confirmation Email templates in one place
Cross-link banners between Numbering and Email Templates for quick navigation
Old /settings/invoices URLs redirect to /settings/documents for backward compatibility

title: Self-service password reset via email
description: Users can now reset their password via email from the login page. Admins triggering a password reset also send the link by email when SMTP is configured.
details: Added 'Forgot Password?' link on the login page
New self-service password reset form that sends a reset link via tenant SMTP
Public requestPasswordReset mutation — same response for known/unknown emails (no enumeration)
Rate limiting: max 5 reset requests per email per 15 minutes
Admin-triggered password reset now also emails the link when SMTP is configured
DE/EN email templates for password reset
OpenSpec change: password-reset-email (proposal, specs, design, tasks)

title: Two-factor authentication (TOTP & Email)
description: Full two-factor authentication support with authenticator app (TOTP) and email code methods. Tenant admins can enforce 2FA for all users.
details: Two 2FA methods: Authenticator App (TOTP) and Email Code
Two-step login flow: credentials → verification code → JWT tokens
TOTP setup with QR code, provisioning URI, and 10 single-use recovery codes
Email 2FA sends 6-digit codes via tenant SMTP (5-minute expiry)
Rate limiting on verification attempts (5 per 15 minutes)
Tenant-level 2FA enforcement — users without 2FA are redirected to setup
Admin can reset any user's 2FA configuration
Security settings section in user profile for 2FA management
Security sub-tab in tenant settings for enforcement toggle
2FA status badges on user administration list
Encrypted TOTP secret storage (Fernet + SECRET_KEY)
Hashed recovery codes (SHA-256)
Full DE/EN localization for all 2FA UI strings
OpenSpec change: two-factor-authentication (proposal, specs, design, tasks)

title: Price increase drill-down and dashboard settings
description: Dashboard and forecasts price increase cards now link to a detailed per-contract view. Users can toggle dashboard sections and contract list date columns. Frontend caching improved for faster deploys.
details: Added clickable price increase cards on dashboard and forecasts linking to filtered contract list
Added per-contract price increase detail table on forecasts tab with sortable columns
Added per-user dashboard section visibility settings (toggle Contract KPIs, New Business, etc.)
Made Start/End Date columns optional in contract list with a persisted toggle (default off)
Removed Order Confirmation column from contract list
Added amber warning banner when table columns overflow the viewport
